title: Verb + 続ける
shortExplanation: To continue doing or to keep doing an action.
longExplanation: The grammar point 続ける (tsuzukeru) is attached to the masu-stem form of verbs, and it indicates the ongoing continuity of an action. It can be translated as 'to continue doing' or 'to keep doing' in English.

examples.jp: 彼は毎日ジムで運動を続けています。
examples.romaji: Kare wa mainichi jimu de undou o tsuzuketeimasu.
examples.en: He continues to exercise at the gym every day.

examples.jp: 彼女は勉強を続けるために図書館に行きました。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa benkyou o tsuzukeru tame ni toshokan ni ikimashita.
examples.en: She went to the library to continue studying.

examples.jp: 私たちは雨にも関わらず散歩を続けました。
examples.romaji: Watashitachi wa ame ni mo kakawarazu sanpo o tsuzukemashita.
examples.en: We continued walking despite the rain.

examples.jp: 彼は仕事を続けることに決めた。
examples.romaji: Kare wa shigoto o tsuzukeru koto ni kimeta.
